bad-base.reason: a failing git diff is exit 2 with git's message, not 'nothing to check' with exit 0

base-swallows-flag.reason: --base refuses a following flag as its value instead of using --plan as the ref

explicit-absolute.reason: an absolute path inside the repository is cleaned to its repo-relative form

explicit-dot-slash.reason: ./x and x are one file; the leading ./ is cleaned away before classification and suite naming

explicit-duplicates.reason: a file named twice is one file

explicit-empty.reason: --files with no file is a usage error, exit 2, not 'nothing to check'

explicit-missing.reason: a named path that does not exist is said on stderr, not dropped silently; a list naming no existing file is exit 2, not nothing to check

explicit-then-flag.reason: flags after --files are flags: --plan plans instead of being swallowed as a file and running the real checks

file-src-go-golangci-yml.reason: the src-go rule precedes the YAML rule, so the lint config runs the Go gate instead of being reported uncovered

git-deleted-allowlisted.reason: a deleted allowlisted script runs the bash-limits gate (the ratchet needs --update) instead of 'nothing to check'

git-deleted-go.reason: a deleted Go file runs the Go gate and the suites of the command whose closure it was in

git-deleted-named-by-suite.reason: a deleted file selects the suites that name it, and a deleted shell script runs the bash-limits gate

git-modified-untracked-deleted.reason: the deleted file is counted and selects the suites that name it; it still gets no per-file check

file-semgrep-bash-conventions-yml.reason: the bash-convention rules file runs the patterns gate instead of being skipped as an excluded tree

group-everything.reason: the lint config is covered by the Go gate; two changed main.go are both credited and listed, and no longer reported uncovered; the changed rules file runs the patterns gate

group-same-basename.reason: every changed file with the same basename is credited and named by the suite, none reported uncovered

help.reason: usage goes to stdout for --help; the text is the tool's own, not the script's header comment

unknown-flag.reason: the usage after an error is the tool's own text, not the script's header comment

run-gate-exit-2.reason: a gate that exits 2 is reported 'could not run (exit 2)' and the run exits 2 when nothing else failed; shellcheck reads the files a changed script sources (--external-sources), as the full gate does

run-gate-exit-2-and-fail.reason: a check that failed outranks a gate that could not run (exit 1); the report line says 'could not run (exit 2)'; shellcheck reads the files a changed script sources (--external-sources), as the full gate does

run-suite-zero-count.reason: a suite that exits 0 after counting 'passed: 0' ran no assertion and could not run (exit 2); the bash ticked it

run-suite-count-reports-failures.reason: a suite that exits 0 while its count line says 'failed: 2' is a failed suite (exit 1); the bash ticked it

run-all-pass.reason: shellcheck reads the files a changed script sources (--external-sources), as the full gate does

run-bash-syntax-error.reason: shellcheck reads the files a changed script sources (--external-sources), as the full gate does
